Using the pipe operator
```{r}
input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)

result1 <- input_vec |>
  mean() |>
  abs() |>
  round()

print(result1)
```

Making comparisons
```{r}
y <- 12

print(y == 7)
print(y < 15)
print(y > 20)
print(y <= 12)
```
